offline_mode.title: Offline Mode
offline_mode.description: Offline mode uses only downloads and other content already stored on this device. Search, Browse, sync, and anything that needs the internet stay unavailable until you turn it off.
offline_mode.unavailable: This screen isn't available in offline mode.

downloads.auto_download_default_description: When on, podcasts you subscribe to start with auto download enabled. You can still change each podcast in its settings.
downloads.auto_download_cellular_default_descripti: When off, auto download waits for Wi‑Fi. New auto-download podcasts inherit this choice.
downloads.auto_download_apply_body: Apply this to all {count} subscribed podcasts, or only to podcasts you subscribe to later?
downloads.auto_download_cellular_apply_body: Apply this cellular setting to all {count} podcasts with auto download on, or only to podcasts you enable later?
downloads.auto_download_catch_up_description: After the app has been closed, auto download keeps only the newest episodes across your podcasts and skips the rest of that catch-up. Episodes that arrive while the app is open are not limited by this.
downloads.auto_delete_on_limit: When My Download Limit Is Reached
downloads.auto_delete_on_limit_description: Deletes the oldest finished downloads first until you are back under the limit.
downloads.auto_delete_on_device_low: When the Phone Is Low on Free Space
downloads.auto_delete_on_device_low_description: Deletes the oldest finished downloads when free space drops below 1 GB, even if you are still under your download limit.
downloads.delete_all_description: Permanently deletes the local media files and download index entries on this device. This cannot be undone.
downloads.delete_all_confirm_body: This deletes every local download file and removes them from the Downloads list. Episodes will need to be downloaded again for offline play.

detail.title: Error Details
detail.not_found: This entry is no longer in the error log
detail.email_overflow: The full report is on the clipboard. Paste it here.
detail.hosted_media_note: Podverse does not host media. Podcasters and artists host their own files and RSS feeds, so an error from their server may need to be fixed by them.

action_error.playback_host_http: The server hosting this media returned an error. Podcasters and artists host their own files, so they may need to fix it.
action_error.playback_network: The connection failed while loading this media. Check your network, then try again.
action_error.playback_unsupported: This file uses a format this device cannot play. The podcast host may need to offer a different file.
action_error.playback_file_not_found: The media file could not be found. It may have been removed from the host.
action_error.playback_decode: This device could not decode the media.
action_error.playback_audio_session: Audio could not start. Close other apps that are playing sound, then try again.
action_error.playback_invalid_source: The media address is not valid.
action_error.playback_unknown: Something went wrong while playing. Try again.
action_error.playback_credentials_required: This feed's host asked for a username and password. Add them to the feed under Add by RSS, then try again.
action_error.playback_credentials_rejected: This feed's host did not accept the saved username and password. Update them under Add by RSS, then try again.
action_error.playback_credentials_withheld_other_doma: This media is on a different site than the feed, so the feed's username and password were not sent to it.
action_error.playback_credentials_withheld_insecure: This media uses an unencrypted address, so the feed's username and password were not sent to it.
action_error.download_credentials_withheld: This file needs the feed's username and password, and downloads on this device do not send them. You can still play it without downloading.
action_error.download_no_storage: There is not enough free space on this device. Free some space, then try again.
action_error.download_transfer_failed: The download did not finish. Check your connection, then try again.
action_error.download_file_missing: The downloaded file is missing from this device.
